description: BOOMELE 2.54mm 1x40P female pin header socket, straight through-hole, square hole. Mates with standard 0.64mm square male pins. Breakaway type — cut to desired pin count. Gold flash contacts, rated 3A per pin.
name: pin-header-female-2-54-1x40
